caption: A wool sweater is pulled off over the head in a dry room, and the hair underneath stands up in all directions.

sa.check: A person wears a wool sweater.
The sweater is pulled off over the head.
The hair underneath stands up in all directions.
The room is indoors and dry-looking: no water or steam.
The hair is flat before the sweater moves and stands up as it comes off.

pc.expect: The hair lies flat until the sweater passes over it, rises as the sweater comes off, stays up for a moment and then settles; it does not rise on its own before.
pc.fail: The hair stands up before the sweater has moved; or rises long after the sweater is off with nothing near it; or stays fully standing to the end of the clip with no sweater near; or rises and falls repeatedly with the sweater gone.

pc.expect: The standing strands stay rooted to the head and fan outward; when they settle they fall back down onto the head.
pc.fail: Strands detach and float up to the ceiling; or the hair settles upward; or the hair stands as a stiff column; or strands hang toward the sweater across the room.

pc.expect: The sweater stretches and folds as knitwear as it comes off; the hair is fine strands that lift individually.
pc.fail: The sweater stays a rigid shape as it lifts; or the hair lifts as one stiff sheet; or the sweater stretches out like elastic and snaps back.

pc.expect: Once off, the sweater lies still where it is put; nothing else in the room stirs.
pc.fail: The sweater floats or slides by itself; or objects nearby jump as the sweater comes off; or the person's clothing underneath ripples with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One person with one head of hair; the sweater passes over the head, not through it; the person and the room keep their shapes.
pc.fail: The sweater passes through the head or body; or the head changes shape; or a second sweater appears; or hair detaches and hangs in the air.

pc.expect: The sweater's colour and pattern, the hair's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The sweater changes colour; or the hair changes colour or length; or the room's contents rearrange.

note: The person is kept because the hair is the physics; their movements are not judged.
